alerts.title: Viral load monitoring due: last VL 113 days ago on DTG-based ART
alerts.message: Guidance for patients on two NRTIs plus DTG states viral load should be checked every 6 months, with 12-monthly testing only if VL is below 50 copies/mL for over one year with reliable adherence. The patient's last viral load was 40 copies/mL on 2025-10-01, 113 days before this visit, so it is not yet overdue at the 6-month interval. Adherence is reported as good and the most recent VL is suppressed, so no immediate concern is raised, but the next VL should be scheduled around 6 months from the last test. Creatinine was last recorded 478 days ago (2024-10-01), with no renal monitoring since, which is a gap for a patient on TDF.

evidence.recommended_action: Schedule next viral load within 6 months of 2025-10-01 per DTG-based ART monitoring. Obtain an up-to-date serum creatinine given TDF use and no result in over a year.
